title: txt-csv-matching output
description: One finding per record that is evidence for a reported value: every transaction, master-data row, rate or minutes item the value rests on; empty if there is none.

source_type.description: "file" for a file in the evidence folder, "table" for a database table.

source.description: Name of the evidence file (e.g. payments.csv), or of the database table.

record_id.description: ID of the record: a CSV row's ID (first column), a minutes item's ID, or a table row's primary key.

reasoning.description: One line explaining which reported value the record supports and how.
